name: Tower of London
countries: United Kingdom of Great Britain and Northern Ireland
description: The Tower of London is a riverside fortress on the north bank of the Thames, begun by William the Conqueror after the Norman Conquest. Its central White Tower, raised in 1078, is ringed by two walls and a moat. Over the centuries it has served as a royal palace, prison, armoury and menagerie, and it still guards the Crown Jewels.
